info.title: SMSINDIAHUB (India) Universal API
info.description: SMSINDIAHUB (India) is an India-focused A2P messaging provider offering domestic HTTP SMS APIs that can authenticate with an API key, plus separate 2FA OTP endpoints with their own API-key flow.
